package: CR-097 · Admin A27 注册诊断（按地址逐阶段）+ 被限流的注册写审计
environment: http://127.0.0.1:33937 — isolated synthetic instance (synwevo_server create_app role=all, start_jobs=False), SYNWEVO_REGISTRATION=open, MAIL_MODE=file without a worker (outbox rows only, so mail stays 'queued'), no human-verification provider configured; a random institutional-form address (1155NNNNNN@link.cuhk.edu.hk) registered through the public API; no production data, model, payment or outbound network; Playwright Chrome
guards: check_boundaries, check_brand, check_design, check_component_names, brand_assets --check: ok

console_errors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)

notes: the 'bad_address' step typed user@example.com. into the card's e-mail input: the browser's own e-mail validation refuses the trailing-dot address before any request, so no server refusal appears there; the server's bad_email answer is asserted by the backend test
the human-verification stage reads 'no record' because the isolated instance configures no provider; with a provider, auth.challenge events from the same source address within 15 minutes are listed
the console's single 'Failed to load resource' entry is the login page's session probe (401)
not_done: a provider's delivery receipt beyond the outbox state (the mail worker records status/attempts/error code; no external receipt exists)
